services.name: Rose Cabin
services.desc: Our rental cabins offer rustic accommodations for your stay. They are located within walking distance of shared bathrooms and showers. Smoking/vaping and pets are prohibited in all cabins. Along with food and beverages, bring plastic/foil wrap, paper products, cooking oils and seasonings. Towels: bath, beach towels, and towels to put between you and whatever you sit on when nude. Bed linens, pillows and one blanket or light weight comforter are provided for most sleepingareas.
